name: LG Electronics India Ltd.
business_summary: Indian subsidiary (85% owned by LG Electronics Inc., Korea) that manufactures and sells home appliances (refrigerators, washing machines, ACs, microwaves) and home entertainment (TVs) from plants in Noida and Pune, with Sri City capacity added; also B2B (commercial AC, display) and service/AMC businesses, and a growing export arm (60+ countries, record exports Q1 FY27). IPO'd in October 2025. EBITDA margin ~12.5% (Q1 FY27), the highest among listed appliance peers. Board approved entry into a new business on 2026-11-05 (details not read). Screener fundamentals for this ticker were empty in the data pack.

revenue_mix.geography: India ~90% / exports ~10% (approximate; H&A grew 13.6% in Q1 FY27)

exposures.mechanism: Imports of compressors/panels/components from LG group ~45% of costs (royalty to parent ~3.5% of sales also USD-linked, model knowledge); exports now material (record in Q1) give a natural hedge of ~10-12% of sales. Net USD short ~35% of costs => +3% USD/INR => +1.05% costs; at 12.5% margin EBITDA -7.4% unpriced, 60% passed through => -3%; persistence 0.4, EV/MCap ~0.95 => -1.1; shaded to -1.5 because pass-through lags.

evidence.note: Q1 FY27: revenue ~Rs7,233cr (+15.5%), PAT Rs653cr (+27%), EBITDA margin ~12.5% (+106bp), record exports; FY27 target mid-teen growth, early double-digit EBITDA margin
